newsitem.title: USA: San Francisco Financing Auth issues postponed.
newsitem.headline: San Francisco Financing Auth issues postponed.

text.p: Three San Francsico City and County Redevelopment Financing Authority, Calif., bond issues have been postponed until possibly the first week of January, according to financial adviser Stephens, McCarthy, Kuenzel & Caldwell.
--$23.6 million of 1996 Series D tax allocation revenue refunding bonds.
--$11.6 million of 1996 Series C taxable tax allocation revenue bonds.
--$28.6 million of 1996 Series B tax allocation revenue bonds.
